title: nwpc-data-client data config (rendered, format-independent)
description: Structural schema for a RENDERED nwpc-data-client data config (all template actions already executed). Raw v2/v3 config files are Go templates and cannot be validated with this schema; use `nwpc_data_client config lint` for them. This schema mirrors the Go-side validation in common.ValidateDataConfig.

_config_version.description: Config format version. Static text only (no template actions). Absent means v1 for old files.

level.description: Single level or a "/"-joined combination (e.g. "runtime/archive", used by existing configs).
